title: Security scans
intro: Check the servers you run for malware, unexpected file changes, weak host settings and vulnerable images.
noServers: No servers yet. Scans appear here once Polaris runs apps on a server.
loadFailed: Could not load this server. Try again in a moment.

malware.hint: Scans app data for known malware. Signatures are fetched the first time and refreshed on every scan.
malware.found: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing found} one {# file found} other {# files found}}
malware.deleteConfirm: Delete this file for good? It cannot be restored afterwards.
malware.noVolumes: No app on this server keeps data in a volume yet, so there is nothing to scan.

files.hint: Record every file's fingerprint once, then check later what was added, removed or changed.

host.hint: Audits the server's own settings against hardening checks. The host is only read.
host.updatesHint: Lets the server install its distribution's security updates by itself.
host.updatesUnsupported: This server's distribution has no supported automatic updates mechanism.
host.scheduleHint: Runs every scan on this server on its own, one at a time.
host.window: Updates install each night around 04:00, the server's own time.
host.waiting: {count, plural, =0 {Up to date.} one {# update waiting ({security} security).} other {# updates waiting ({security} security).}}
host.restartNeeded: A restart is needed to finish them.
host.offByHand: Turned off by hand on {when}. Polaris leaves them off.

images.hint: Checks each app's running image for known vulnerabilities and lists its software.
images.allHint: Every image this server runs, once each however many containers use it. New images are checked on their own, and each one again within a week.
images.none: This server runs no containers yet.
images.listUnavailable: This server could not list its containers, so apps are checked one by one.
images.noApps: No apps on this server yet.
images.turnOffQuestion: The {feature} stops and its container is removed.
images.turnOffDenied: Only someone who manages this feature can turn it off.
images.turnOffBody: Turn it on again from its own page.

queued: Scan queued. It starts as soon as the server is free.

errors.invalid: Check the values and try again.
errors.noVolumes: That volume is no longer on this server.
errors.noBaseline: Record a baseline for this folder first.
errors.noApp: That app is no longer on this server.
errors.notRunning: This app has no running release to scan.
errors.noSignatures: Malware signatures could not be downloaded. Check that the server reaches the internet.
errors.scanError: The scan stopped with an error. Try again.
errors.tooManyFiles: Too many files to record here. Pick a smaller folder.
errors.noFolder: That folder does not exist in the volume.
errors.noTool: The audit tools could not be downloaded. Check that the server reaches the internet.
errors.daemonOutdated: This needs a newer Polaris. Update from Settings, then try again.
errors.noDaemon: This Polaris runs without its host service, so it cannot check this machine. Servers added over SSH can be checked.
errors.busy: Another host check is running on this server. Try again when it ends.
errors.lost: The scan stopped before it finished. Try again.
errors.timeout: The scan took too long and was stopped.
errors.fileGone: The file is no longer there.
errors.pathTaken: A file already exists where this one would be restored.
errors.quarantineFailed: The file could not be moved. Try again.
errors.updatesFailed: Could not read or change automatic updates on this server.
errors.imageMissing: The image this app runs is no longer on the server. Redeploy the app, then scan again.
errors.noRoom: Not enough free disk on the server to check this image. Free some space, then try again.
errors.scannerFailed: The vulnerability scanner stopped with an error. Try again.
errors.reportUnreadable: The scanner's report could not be read. Update Polaris from Settings, then scan again.
errors.sidecarRefused: It could not be turned off. Try again from its own page.
errors.fixFailed: The security updates could not be applied. Try again later.
errors.fixUnsupported: This server's distribution has no supported updates tool.
errors.packageMissing: That package is not installed on this server.
errors.holdFailed: The package manager refused the change. Try again later.
errors.versionGone: That version is no longer offered for this server. Pick another one.
errors.rollbackFailed: The package could not move to that version. Try another one.
errors.firewallFailed: The firewall could not be read or changed on this server.
errors.firewallRouter: This server is the network's router; its firewall is managed in the Router app.
errors.firewallUnavailable: This server's system has no firewall Polaris can manage.
errors.firewallRolledBack: The server undid the change because Polaris could not reach it afterwards. Nothing was left closed.
errors.firewallUnconfirmed: Polaris could not confirm the change in time, so the server undoes it by itself within two minutes.
errors.sshFailed: SSH sign-in could not be read or changed on this server.
errors.sshUnavailable: This server has no SSH server Polaris can manage.
errors.sshNoKeys: No account on this server has a key, so passwords stay on.
errors.sshPolarisPassword: Polaris signs in to this server with a password. Edit the server to use a key first.
errors.sshInvalid: The server refused the new SSH settings, so nothing changed.
errors.sshOverridden: Another SSH setting on this server keeps passwords on, so nothing changed.
errors.sshRolledBack: The server undid the change because a key could not sign in afterwards. Passwords still work.
errors.sshUnconfirmed: Polaris could not confirm the change in time, so the server undoes it by itself within two minutes.

alerts.title: {count, plural, one {A new serious vulnerability in {app}} other {# new serious vulnerabilities in {app}}}

findings.none: No known vulnerabilities in this image.
findings.failed: Could not load the findings. Try again.

refreshFailed: Could not refresh. Showing the last results.

focus.gone: This scan is no longer kept. The newest scans of the server are below.
focus.serverGone: That server is no longer in Polaris. Showing another one.
focus.running: This scan has not finished yet. The page updates when it does.
focus.loadFailed: Could not open this scan. Try again.
focus.appGone: The app this scan was about has been removed since.

verdict.issues: {count, plural, =0 {No known issues} one {# issue} other {# issues}}
verdict.fixAll: All of them are fixed in a newer version.
verdict.fixSome: {count, plural, one {# of them is fixed in a newer version.} other {# of them are fixed in a newer version.}}

next.updateApp: Update {app} to its latest version, then scan again.
next.updatePolaris: Update Polaris from Settings, then scan again.
next.updateImage: Run a newer version of this image, then scan again.
next.updateDeps: Update these dependencies in the repository, then deploy again.
next.wait: No fix is out yet. Scan again later to see if one has been released.
next.updateHost: Apply the security updates on the server, then check again.

armed.title: Automatic security updates are on for {server}
armed.body: Polaris turned them on. They install each night around 04:00; you can turn them off in Security scans.

restart.title: {server} needs a restart
restart.body: Security updates are installed and need a restart to finish. Schedule it for 04:30 from Security scans.

packages.label: Installed packages
packages.applyHint: Installs the distribution's security updates on this server now. Held packages stay as they are.

fix.unavailable: The updates tool is missing; turn automatic updates on to install it.
fix.unsupported: This distribution has no supported updates tool.
fix.off: Automatic updates are off, so nothing was installed.

held.title: Held packages
held.hint: Held packages stay on their version. Automatic updates skip them.
held.dialogTitle: Hold or roll back a package
held.dialogHint: For when an update broke something: keep a package where it is, or move it to a version the server still offers.
held.name: Package
held.nameInvalid: Letters, digits and + . _ - only, starting with a letter or digit.
held.noVersions: The server offers no other version of this package.

firewall.title: Firewall

hint.on: Only what Polaris and your apps use is reachable from outside.
hint.armed: A change is being checked. The server undoes it by itself if Polaris cannot reach it again.
hint.router: This server is the network's router; the Router app's firewall protects it.
hint.off: No firewall is on. Every port listening here can be reached from outside.
hint.offCount: {count, plural, one {No firewall is on. # port Polaris does not run is open to anyone.} other {No firewall is on. # ports Polaris does not run are open to anyone.}}
hint.offByHand: Turned off by hand on {when}. Polaris leaves it off.

firewall.dialogHint: Everything not listed as staying open is closed. If Polaris cannot reach the server afterwards, the server undoes the change by itself within two minutes.
firewall.closesNone: Nothing else is listening, so nothing closes.

replaces.ufw: UFW is on here. Polaris's firewall takes its place, and UFW comes back if you turn this one off.
replaces.firewalld: firewalld is on here. Polaris's firewall takes its place, and firewalld comes back if you turn this one off.

firewall.applying: Applying and checking that Polaris still reaches the server. This takes up to two minutes.

review.title: {server} has no firewall
review.body: Every port listening on {server} can be reached from outside. Review what turning the firewall on would close.

ssh.title: SSH sign-in

hint.on: Only a key signs in. Passwords are refused, so they cannot be guessed.
hint.armed: A change is being checked. The server undoes it by itself if a key cannot sign in again.
hint.already: Passwords are already refused here. Only a key signs in.
hint.off: Anyone can try passwords on this server over SSH.
hint.offByHand: Turned off by hand on {when}. Polaris leaves passwords on.
hint.polarisPassword: Passwords still work. Polaris signs in here with a password, so it cannot turn them off.
hint.noKeys: Passwords still work. No account here has a key to sign in with instead.
hint.unavailable: This server has no SSH server Polaris can manage.

ssh.dialogTitle: Sign in with a key only
ssh.dialogHint: Password sign-in is turned off and root keeps only key sign-in. If a key cannot sign in afterwards, the server undoes it by itself within two minutes.
ssh.keeps: Keep signing in with a key
ssh.losesHint: These accounts only have a password.

blocked.unavailable: This server has no SSH server Polaris can manage.
blocked.passwordLogin: Polaris signs in here with a password. Edit the server to use a key first.
blocked.noKeys: No account here has a key, so turning passwords off would lock everyone out.

ssh.applying: Applying and checking that a key still signs in...
ssh.done: Passwords are off on this server.

notify.title: {server} still takes passwords
notify.body: Anyone can try passwords on {server} over SSH. Review who keeps access and turn passwords off.
